notes.title: Major Update 1! (Cozy and Hardcore Mode Added + New Luck Flower)
notes.content:
Major Update 1
Cozy, Mixed and Hardcore Mode added!  Along with the new Flower/Spell Luck and dozens of quality fixes and optimizations. 

Cozy Mode : 
- Enemies have less health
- Enemies move slightly slower 
- Player starts with more max health
- The music stays calm even with enemies on screen

Hardcore Mode :
- Enemies have more health
- Enemies move slightly faster
- Players start with less max health
- Free seeds and fruit don’t respawn 

Luck Flower:
A flower that produces a spell that doubles the amount of resources you get for a short time.

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Patch 1 :
- The camera follows the player on dashing for smoother visuals
- The large robots slam attack now shows you it's range before it lands
- Map crashing hopefully fixed for all systems
- Players can now window the game
- Loading trigger above Elowen fixed
- Extra effects for final boss death
